# Brushland Game Wiki

> Fan wiki for Brushland, the fairytale kingdom-builder by Transhuman Design where you paint the land and villagers move in — paint mechanics, villager AI, release news and guides.

Site: https://brushlandgame.wiki

- Trailer Breakdown — the reveal, frame by frame: https://brushlandgame.wiki/guide/trailer-breakdown
- Release Guide — every dated signal: https://brushlandgame.wiki/guide/release-guide
